items.feedback: Correct. The loop tests wording, so it exits on "done" while the edit_file call is still pending. Control flow should read structure (tool calls), not prose.
Correct: 6 tool-call turns plus 1 final text-only turn is 7. With 6, the run would end as error_max_turns with no final response, even though the work was done.
Correct. Only the success variant carries result, so check the subtype before reading it.
Correct. max_tokens means the reply was truncated, not finished, and a tool call inside it may be incomplete. Raise the limit or ask the model to continue.

summary: 4 of 4 correct. You have down what ends an agent loop (no tool call), why wording is not the signal, how max_turns counts the final reply, and that max_tokens means truncated. Next: other stop_reason values (refusal, pause_turn, model_context_window_exceeded) and how a harness should handle each. Ask for a lesson on that when ready.
